question: Find the average unite price for a track.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: Find all the customer last names that do nout have invoice totals larger than 20.
gold_sql: SELECT LastName FROM CUSTOMER EXCEPT SELECT T1.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId  =  T2.CustomerId WHERE T2.total  >  20

question: What are the distinct billing countries of the invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT BILLINGCOUNTRY FROM INVOICE

question: How many distinct cities does the employee live in?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM EMPLOYEE

question: List the phone numbers of all employees.
gold_sql: SELECT Phone FROM EMPLOYEE

question: What are the invoice dates for customers with the first name Astrid and the last name Gruber?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.InvoiceDate FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId  WHERE T1.FirstName ='Astrid' AND T1.LastName = 'Gruber'

question: What are the addresses of customers living in Germany who have had an invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Address FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId WHERE T1.Country = 'Germany'

question: Find the number of albums by that artist Metallica
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T2.Name = 'Metallica'

question: What are the duration of the longest and shortest pop tracks in milliseconds?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(T2.Milliseconds), MIN(T2.Milliseconds) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Name = 'Pop';

question: Count the number of tracks that are of the media type 'AAC audio file'.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEDIATYPE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId WHERE T1.Name = 'AAC audio file';

question: What is the first name and last name employee helps the customer with first name Leonie?
adaptation_notes: none needed chinook uses identical table/column names
gold_sql: SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId WHERE T1.FirstName = 'Leonie';

question: What are the first names and support rep ids for employees serving 10 or more customers?
adaptation_notes: corrected original gold SQL it selected customer's firstName instead of employee's and wasn't grouped correctly
gold_sql: SELECT T2.FirstName, T1.SupportRepId FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId GROUP BY T1.SupportRepId, T2.FirstName HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;

question: What is the least commone media type in all tracks?
adaptation_notes: tightened the GROUP BY to include both MediaTypeId and Name for correctness
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM MEDIATYPE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T1.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.NAME FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the titles and ids for albums containing tracks with unit price greater than 1?
adaptation_notes: added Title to the GROUP BY for correctness
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Title, T2.AlbumId FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T2.UnitPrice > 1 GROUP BY T2.AlbumId, T1.Title;

question: What are the last names of employees who serve at most 20 customers, including employees who serve no customers?
adaptation_notes: corrected original gold SQL it selected customer's LastName instead of the employee's,
gold_sql: SELECT T2.LastName FROM EMPLOYEE AS T2 LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER AS T1 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId GROUP BY T2.EmployeeId, T2.LastName HAVING COUNT(T1.CustomerId) <= 20;

question: Count the number of artists who have not realeased an album?
adaptation_notes: used NOT EXISTS instead of original NOT IN for NULL
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ARTIST AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALBUM AS T2 WHERE T2.ArtistId = T1.ArtistId);
